chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, all from Ibn Mahboub, from Umar ibn Yazeed, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about a man who died and left his wife while she was pregnant, so she gave birth to a boy after his death. Then the boy died after falling onto the ground. The midwife who received him testified that he cried out and shrieked when he fell onto the ground, then died after that. He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is upon the Imam to validate her testimony regarding one-quarter of the inheritance of the boy.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a newborn's inheritance if they die immediately after birth and only the midwife testifies?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the evidentiary standard for establishing a newborn's viability (istihlal) through the midwife's testimony of a cry upon birth, a crucial prerequisite for inheritance rights in Shia jurisprudence. It specifically grants the mother one-quarter of the infant's estate, reflecting the principle that the child is considered a distinct heir from the moment of live birth, even if death follows immediately. This ruling underscores the importance of physical signs of life in determining legal personhood and inheritance distribution within the family structure.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and a number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who died and left his woman, and she was pregnant. So there was born, after his death, a boy. Then the boy died after having fallen upon the ground. So, the woman who was the midwife testified that he moved and shrieked when he fell upon the ground, then died after that. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is upon the Imam<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>asws</sup> allow her testimony regarding the one-quarter of the inheritance of the boy’. (p.s. – two men or four women is the requirement of the testimony).
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad all from ibn Mahbub from ‘Umar ibn Yazid who has narrated the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who dies leaving behind a woman who is pregnant. She gives birth after his death and the boy dies after falling on the ground. The female nurse saw and heard him crying when falling on the ground but then died. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is up to the Imam to apply her testimony for the one-fourth of the legacy of the boy.’” (The testimony of the nurse is one out of four needed)
